expertText:
; ==========================================
; Ultimate turbo demo: 64 sprites, changing CPU speed
; ==========================================
; Runs on a C64 Ultimate or an Ultimate 64 only, with the turbo registers on:
;   menu (F2) -> U64 Specific Settings -> Turbo Control = C64U Turbo Registers
;   (U64 Turbo Registers on the Ultimate 64 firmware). The Ultimate emulator
;   run mode of VA turns it on by itself. Anywhere else $D031 does not read
;   back, and the demo only says so.
;
; $D031: bits 0-3 = speed index (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24,
;   32, 40, 48, 64 MHz), bit 7 = badline timing off. Raster timing, the VIC
;   and the SID stay at 1 MHz; only the CPU runs faster.
;
; The speed changes every 3 seconds: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 MHz and back.
; The work per frame
;   main loop: 3 software multiplies per sprite for the X positions
;     (192 in all, about 30000 cycles), then the Y sort. The border is red
;     while it runs: at 1 MHz it takes several frames (low FPS).
;   mux IRQs: a whole row of 8 sprites is due on the same raster line and
;     must be set within 2 lines. At 1 MHz that takes about 9 lines, so the
;     last balls of each row are missing; from 4 MHz all 64 are shown.

* = $0801

.const NUM = 64
.const IRQ_TOP = 30
.const IRQ_BOTTOM = 250
.const AMP2 = 112
.const AMP3 = 24
; the ball sprite sits at $3000 (see the end), data page $3000 / 64 = $C0
.const SPR_PAGE = $C0
.const STATUS = $07C0
; frames each speed is kept
.const HOLD = 150

    JMP init

.region Init
init:
    SEI
    LDA #$00
    STA $D020
    STA $D021
    STA $D017
    STA $D01D
    STA $D01C
; sprites behind the text, so the status line stays readable
    LDA #$FF
    STA $D01B
    LDA #$01
    STA $0286
    JSR $E544
; the turbo register reads back only on an Ultimate with the turbo registers on
    LDA #$01
    STA $D031
    LDA $D031
    CMP #$01
    BNE not_ultimate
    LDA #$00
    STA $D031
    LDA $D031
    LBEQ is_ultimate
not_ultimate:
    LDA #$02
    STA $D020
.text 5, 9, "THIS DEMO NEEDS A C64 ULTIMATE"
.text 9, 10, "OR AN ULTIMATE 64."
.text 2, 13, "TURN ON THE TURBO REGISTERS: F2 MENU,"
.text 2, 14, "U64 SPECIFIC SETTINGS, TURBO CONTROL"
.text 2, 15, "= C64U / U64 TURBO REGISTERS."
not_ultimate_wait:
    JMP not_ultimate_wait
is_ultimate:
.text 5, 0, "VA ULTIMATE TURBO MULTIPLEXER"
.text 0, 24, "TURBO    MHZ   FPS      64 SPRITES"
    LDA #$FF
    STA $D015
    LDX #NUM-1
init_order:
    TXA
    STA order,X
    LDA vcol,X
    STA vcol_now,X
    DEX
    BPL init_order
    JSR set_speed
    JSR move
    JSR sort
    LDA #$7F
    STA $DC0D
    LDA $DC0D
    LDA #<irq_top
    STA $0314
    LDA #>irq_top
    STA $0315
    LDA #IRQ_TOP
    STA $D012
    LDA $D011
    AND #$7F
    STA $D011
    LDA #$01
    STA $D01A
    STA $D019
    CLI
.endregion

.region Main loop
main_loop:
    LDA frame_done
    BEQ main_loop
    LDA #$00
    STA frame_done
    LDA #$02
    STA $D020
    JSR move
    JSR sort
    LDA #$00
    STA $D020
    INC loops
    LDA speed_due
    BEQ main_status
    LDA #$00
    STA speed_due
    JSR next_speed
main_status:
    JSR show_status
    JMP main_loop
.endregion

.region Speed
; next speed of the cycle; the list ends with $FF
next_speed:
    INC seq_pos
    LDX seq_pos
    LDA speed_seq,X
    BPL next_speed_set
    LDX #$00
    STX seq_pos
    LDA speed_seq
next_speed_set:
    STA speed

; speed index -> $D031
set_speed:
    LDA speed
    STA $D031
    RTS

; MHz and the frames computed in the last second, on the bottom line
show_status:
    LDA speed
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA mhz_text,X
    STA STATUS+6
    LDA mhz_text+1,X
    STA STATUS+7
    LDA fps
    LDX #$30
fps_tens:
    CMP #10
    BCC fps_units
    SBC #10
    INX
    JMP fps_tens
fps_units:
    ORA #$30
    STA STATUS+19
    STX STATUS+18
    RTS
.endregion

.region Movement
; x = xbase + (sin1 * ampx + sin2 * AMP2 + sin3 * AMP3) / 256, ampx breathing
; y = row base + bob, the same for every row so rows stay 24 lines apart
move:
    INC phase
    LDA phase_x
    CLC
    ADC #$02
    STA phase_x
    DEC phase_x2
    LDA phase3
    CLC
    ADC #$05
    STA phase3
    INC slow
    LDY slow
    LDA xtab,Y
    LSR
    LSR
    CLC
    ADC #96
    STA ampx
    LDA #160
    SEC
    SBC ampx
    LSR
    CLC
    ADC #24
    STA xbase
    LDY phase
    LDA bob,Y
    STA bobv
    LDX #$07
row_loop:
    LDA rowbase,X
    CLC
    ADC bobv
    STA rowy,X
    DEX
    BPL row_loop
    LDA #NUM-1
    STA idx
move_loop:
    LDX idx
    LDA xoff,X
    CLC
    ADC phase_x
    TAY
    LDA xtab,Y
    LDY ampx
    JSR mulhi
    STA sum_lo
    LDA #$00
    STA sum_hi
    LDX idx
    LDA xoff2,X
    CLC
    ADC phase_x2
    TAY
    LDA xtab,Y
    LDY #AMP2
    JSR mulhi
    CLC
    ADC sum_lo
    STA sum_lo
    BCC move_sum2
    INC sum_hi
move_sum2:
    LDX idx
    LDA xoff3,X
    CLC
    ADC phase3
    TAY
    LDA xtab,Y
    LDY #AMP3
    JSR mulhi
    CLC
    ADC sum_lo
    STA sum_lo
    BCC move_sum3
    INC sum_hi
move_sum3:
    LDX idx
    LDA sum_lo
    CLC
    ADC xbase
    STA vxlo,X
    LDA sum_hi
    ADC #$00
    STA vxhi,X
    LDY rowof,X
    LDA rowy,Y
    STA vy,X
    DEC idx
    BPL move_loop
    RTS

; A = (A * Y) / 256, shift and add (X is used)
mulhi:
    STA mul_a
    STY mul_b
    LDA #$00
    LDX #$08
    LSR mul_b
mul_loop:
    BCC mul_skip
    CLC
    ADC mul_a
mul_skip:
    ROR
    ROR mul_b
    DEX
    BNE mul_loop
    RTS
.endregion

.region Sort
; insertion sort of `order` by vy (ascending)
sort:
    LDA #$01
    STA sort_i
sort_outer:
    LDX sort_i
    LDA order,X
    STA sort_key
    TAY
    LDA vy,Y
    STA sort_y
sort_inner:
    CPX #$00
    BEQ sort_place
    LDY order-1,X
    LDA vy,Y
    CMP sort_y
    BCC sort_place
    BEQ sort_place
    TYA
    STA order,X
    DEX
    JMP sort_inner
sort_place:
    LDA sort_key
    STA order,X
    INC sort_i
    LDA sort_i
    CMP #NUM
    BNE sort_outer
    RTS
.endregion

.region Raster IRQs
irq_top:
    LDA #$FF
    STA $D019
    LDX #$00
top_loop:
    JSR show
    INX
    CPX #$08
    BNE top_loop
    STX next
    JMP mux_check

irq_mux:
    LDA #$FF
    STA $D019
mux_show:
    LDX next
    JSR show
    INX
    STX next
; X = next sorted sprite: show it now if its hardware sprite is free, else wait for that line
mux_check:
    CPX #NUM
    BEQ to_bottom
    LDY order-8,X
    LDA vy,Y
    CLC
    ADC #22
    STA irq_line
    LDA $D012
    CLC
    ADC #$03
    CMP irq_line
    BCS mux_show
    LDA irq_line
    STA $D012
    LDA #<irq_mux
    STA $0314
    LDA #>irq_mux
    STA $0315
    JMP $EA81

to_bottom:
    LDA #IRQ_BOTTOM
    STA $D012
    LDA #<irq_bottom
    STA $0314
    LDA #>irq_bottom
    STA $0315
    JMP $EA81

irq_bottom:
    LDA #$FF
    STA $D019
    INC frame_done
    INC ticks
    LDA ticks
    CMP #50
    BNE irq_bottom_next
    LDA #$00
    STA ticks
    LDA loops
    STA fps
    LDA #$00
    STA loops
irq_bottom_next:
    DEC hold
    BNE irq_bottom_hold
    LDA #HOLD
    STA hold
    INC speed_due
irq_bottom_hold:
    LDA #IRQ_TOP
    STA $D012
    LDA #<irq_top
    STA $0314
    LDA #>irq_top
    STA $0315
    JMP $EA81

; sorted sprite X -> hardware sprite X & 7 (X is preserved)
show:
    STX show_pos
    LDY order,X
    TXA
    AND #$07
    TAX
    LDA #SPR_PAGE
    STA $07F8,X
    LDA vcol_now,Y
    STA $D027,X
    LDA vxhi,Y
    BEQ show_msb_off
    LDA $D010
    ORA bitmask,X
    JMP show_msb
show_msb_off:
    LDA bitmask,X
    EOR #$FF
    AND $D010
show_msb:
    STA $D010
    TXA
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA vxlo,Y
    STA $D000,X
    LDA vy,Y
    STA $D001,X
    LDX show_pos
    RTS
.endregion
